title: Who Owns GTA 6? Take-Two, Rockstar and the Top Shareholders
desc: GTA 6 is owned by Take-Two Interactive (Nasdaq: TTWO) through Rockstar Games. Its largest holders: Vanguard 7.02%, BlackRock, State Street and Saudi PIF.
keywords: who owns gta 6, who owns rockstar games, what company owns rockstar games, who makes gta 6, is rockstar a publicly traded company, take-two shareholders, who owns take-two, gta 6 owner, saudi pif take-two
question: Who owns GTA 6, and who owns the company behind it?
cta: Want search engines and AI assistants to state the facts about your company correctly?
body:
Short answer. GTA 6 is owned by Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc., a public company listed on Nasdaq under the symbol TTWO. Rockstar Games, the label behind Grand Theft Auto, is what Take-Two's annual report of May 22, 2026 calls its "wholly-owned publisher" of the series. No single investor controls Take-Two: in its proxy statement, the largest holder as of July 15, 2026 was Vanguard with 7.02%.

On November 24, 2026 we read Take-Two's own filings with the US Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC): the annual report (Form 10-K), its list of subsidiaries, the 2026 proxy statement, the latest quarterly report and the launch release of November 20, 2026. Every number below comes from a named filing, linked where it is first cited. This is not investment advice; we report what the company filed.

Who owns GTA 6 and Rockstar Games

Take-Two's Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2026 says the company develops and publishes games "principally through Rockstar Games, 2K, and Zynga." It describes Rockstar Games as "our wholly-owned publisher of the Grand Theft Auto, L.A. Noire, Max Payne, Midnight Club, Red Dead Redemption, and other popular franchises."

The GTA 6 launch release repeats the structure. In the release of November 20, 2026, filed with the SEC on Form 8-K, Rockstar Games is "a label of Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. (NASDAQ: TTWO)". So the game, the brand and the studio all sit inside one listed company.

The legal entities are listed in Exhibit 21.1 of the same 10-K, Take-Two's list of subsidiaries. We counted 15 entries that carry the Rockstar name, including:

  • Rockstar Games, Inc. (Delaware)
  • Rockstar Games UK Limited and Rockstar International Limited (United Kingdom)
  • Rockstar Games Toronto ULC (British Columbia)
  • Rockstar San Diego, Inc. (Virginia) and Rockstar New England, Inc. (Delaware)
  • Rockstar London Limited and Rockstar Dundee Limited (United Kingdom)
  • Rockstar Interactive India LLP (India)
  • Take-Two Australia Development Pty Ltd, trading as Rockstar Australia

Who makes GTA 6

Rockstar Games develops and publishes GTA 6; the latest 10-Q says Rockstar "will release Grand Theft Auto VI on November 19, 2026." The company boilerplate in the November 20, 2026 release says Rockstar was "Founded by Sam Houser in 1998" and launched Grand Theft Auto III in 2001. The 10-K adds that "Software titles published by our Rockstar Games label are primarily internally developed," so most of its games are built by Rockstar's own studios.

We found no Rockstar-only headcount in the 10-K. Across the whole company it reported 12,909 full-time employees as of March 31, 2026, including 9,998 in development studios.

Who owns Take-Two, the company behind GTA 6

Take-Two is a Delaware corporation with its head office in New York City. Its common stock "trades on the NASDAQ Global Select Market under the symbol TTWO," the 10-K says. On July 23, 2026, the record date for its annual meeting, 186,980,443 shares were issued and outstanding, according to the 2026 proxy statement.

The 10-K also reports only 269 holders of record as of May 11, 2026. That small number counts registered holders. Most investors hold shares in "street name" through brokers, so they are not counted as holders of record, and the real number of owners is much larger.

The proxy's ownership table lists Take-Two's largest holders, based on their own SEC reports (Schedule 13G). As of July 15, 2026 (JPMorgan Chase, at 4.98%, is just under 5%):

All directors and executive officers (13 people)2,101,0611.12%Proxy statement

Added up, the four holders at 5% or more held 26.36% of the stock (our sum of the proxy's percentages). Those stakes rest on filings of different dates; BlackRock's dates from January 2024. The rest is held by other shareholders. Strauss Zelnick, Take-Two's Executive Chairman and Chief Executive Officer, is listed with 1,382,568 shares, which the proxy marks as less than 1%.

Does Saudi Arabia own part of GTA 6?

Indirectly: PIF owns 6.10% of Take-Two, the company that owns the game. Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund (PIF) held 6.10% of Take-Two as of July 15, 2026, per the proxy statement. The footnote names The Saudi Fourth Investment Company ("Saudi Fourth") and Saudi Electronic Games Holding Company ("Savvy") and explains the chain: "Saudi Fourth is the direct holder of the shares," Savvy is the sole owner of Saudi Fourth, and PIF is the "sole owner of Savvy," so PIF and Savvy "may be deemed to share voting and investment power" over the shares.

A 6.10% stake makes PIF the fourth largest holder in that table. It does not make PIF the owner of Rockstar or of GTA 6; the game belongs to Take-Two, and PIF is one shareholder of Take-Two.

Does Sony or Microsoft own GTA 6?

No. Neither company appears among Take-Two's holders of 5% or more in the proxy statement, and Rockstar is a wholly-owned Take-Two label. Sony and Microsoft are customers. The 10-K says sales to Take-Two's five largest customers made up 80.6% of net revenue in the fiscal year ended March 31, 2026, "with Apple, Sony, Google, and Microsoft each accounting for more than 10.0%."

In other words, the console makers sell Take-Two's games, but they do not own them. The publisher of GTA 6 is Take-Two, through Rockstar.

What GTA is worth to Take-Two

Before GTA 6 came out, Grand Theft Auto products "contributed 12.4% of our net revenue for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2026," the 10-K says. Total net revenue that year was $6,656.4 million, so GTA brought in about $825 million (our calculation: 12.4% of $6,656.4 million). The 10-K also says the series "has sold-in over 465 million units worldwide."

GTA 6 changes the scale. Take-Two's November 20, 2026 release says GTA 6 reached $3.79 billion in day one retail sales, Retail sales are not the same as Take-Two's net revenue, so the two figures should not be compared directly. We cover those launch numbers in our guide to GTA 6 sales and what Take-Two reported.

How much did GTA 6 cost to make? We found no budget for the game in the 10-K or the latest 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. A related public figure is company wide: the balance sheet line "Software development costs and licenses" totals $2,577.3 million on September 30, 2026 (current and long-term balances added together), which covers all of Take-Two's games, not GTA 6 alone.

The business lesson: people search for the owner

Around the launch, "what company owns rockstar games" was a Breakout query in Google Trends for the United States (past 7 days, related to "take-two", read November 24, 2026). People who love a brand often want to know who stands behind it.

We think any business with brands, labels or sub-brands should answer that question on its own site in plain words: who owns what, since when, and where the proof is. A clear statement, like the one in Take-Two's filings, makes it easier for search engines and AI assistants to get the facts right. That is the core of our AI search optimization work: making sure the facts about your company are stated once, clearly, where machines and people can find them.
faqs: Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. owns GTA 6 through Rockstar Games, which its 10-K of May 22, 2026 calls its wholly-owned publisher of the Grand Theft Auto series. Take-Two trades on Nasdaq as TTWO.
Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. Rockstar Games is a wholly-owned label of Take-Two, alongside 2K and Zynga, according to Take-Two's annual report for the year ended March 31, 2026.
Is Rockstar Games a publicly traded company?
No, not on its own. Rockstar Games is part of Take-Two Interactive, and Take-Two is the listed company, on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the symbol TTWO.
Who is the biggest shareholder of Take-Two?

As of July 15, 2026, Vanguard Capital Management with 13,131,908 shares, or 7.02%, per Take-Two's 2026 proxy statement. BlackRock (6.81%), State Street (6.43%) and Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund (6.10%) follow.
Does Sony or Microsoft own GTA 6?
No. Both are customers of Take-Two, each accounting for more than 10% of its net revenue in the fiscal year ended March 31, 2026, but neither appears among its holders of 5% or more.
How much did it cost to make GTA 6?

We found no GTA 6 budget in the Take-Two 10-K or 10-Q we read. Its balance sheet line for software development costs and licenses was $2,577.3 million on September 30, 2026, for all its games combined.

image.takeaway: Rockstar is a wholly-owned Take-Two label; Vanguard was the largest Take-Two holder at 7.02% on July 15, 2026.
